activation.details: Shell restart plus user fcitx5 service restart load the rebuilt add-on; no reboot required.

payload.effects: Long-press accent popups keep working; ordinary taps of accent letters pass through untouched and a hold interrupted by the screensaver or lock no longer loses the key.
payload.explanation: Updating the plugin to the released 1.1.1 replaces the add-on behaviour that lost keys: a tapped key now reaches the application as a normal keydown instead of committed text, a held key is cancelled when focus leaves the field (so the screensaver or lock appearing mid-press no longer swallows it), and the compiled fcitx5 add-on is rebuilt when the plugin source changes.

steps: systemctl --user restart omarchy-fcitx5 (the add-on's systemd drop-in re-runs its build helper via ExecStartPre and replaces the compiled shared object)

Re-enable the accents with: omarchy bar set io.github.heroesofcode.omacento enabled true --json ; the --json form stores a boolean, without it the widget entry keeps a string and its displayed state diverges from the add-on configuration

payload.rollback: Disable without uninstalling: omarchy bar set io.github.heroesofcode.omacento enabled false --json
payload.validation_plan: Let the idle screensaver trigger, lock the session, type a login string that contains several of the affected vowels at normal speed; expect a successful unlock and no new authentication-failure entries for the lock PAM service in the journal. Check the popup still works by holding e for about half a second.
